_meta.purpose: The pre-registered backtest corpus: every 2026 regular-season game the repository can evidence, with settled/unsettled state explicit.
_meta.team_code_alias_note: the vendored third-party archive writes Arizona as ARI, nfl.com writes AZ; the alias is applied once, explicitly, and both codes are retained on every game row
_meta.frozen_archive_note: nflverse/nfldata as vendored in this repo settles exactly 136 of the 272 scheduled 2026 games: all of weeks 1-9 and none of week 10. The brief's '136-game log' is that frozen snapshot. It is not the current state of the league.
_meta.official_reread_note: This session re-read the official week-10 page at 2026-11-15T23:24:27Z and found 9 finals, of which 8 postdate the frozen archive. The official re-read is the authority; the archive is the frozen corpus.

standings_reconciliation.proof: each club that differs is corrected ONLY by adding its official week-10 final; after that addition the W-L-T and PF/PA match the official standings cell for cell. Zero unexplained clubs.
standings_reconciliation.explanation: clubs that differ are clubs whose week-10 game is settled on the official page but not in the frozen archive; the delta must be explained by that, and is checked against the delta table below

price_policy.official_price_source_note: The NFL publishes no betting prices. Every price in this project is third-party and is labelled so.
price_policy.opening_coverage: 2021 only (1,088 rows = 272 games x 4 quote types)
price_policy.closing_coverage: 2011-2025 complete by season; 2026 restricted to the 136 settled games the vendored archive carries prices for
price_policy.decision: DEC-1 (published): no backtest may claim a price-based result for a season with no archived price. Backtests are split into PRICE-VERIFIED (2021, openings+closings) and CLOSE-ONLY (2011-2025) strata, and 2026 is excluded from price backtests because its opening prices do not exist.
